name: review-card-stack
title: Review Card Stack
description: Three short customer review cards (name, stars, a one-line quote) arrive as a stack, then shuffle: the front card swings out and goes to the back so each review comes to the front in turn. Reviews are a variable.
useWhen: Letting a few real customers speak in a short quote each.
A social-proof moment that is more personal than an average rating.
avoidWhen: An average score and how ratings split: use rating-summary.
One long review typed out: use chat-review-typed.
author: Mosio

source.technique: card stack shuffle: layered cards cycling to the front

variables.label: Heading
variables.description: Small line above the stack. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Reviews
variables.description: Two to four reviews separated by semicolons, each as name|stars|quote. Keep the quote free of semicolons.
variables.default: Sari|5|Kopinya enak, harganya masuk akal. Langganan tiap minggu; Budi|5|Pesan lewat chat, 15 menit sudah sampai; Maya|4|Roti bakarnya renyah, porsinya pas

variables.label: Hold on each card
variables.description: Seconds each review stays in front before the next comes up, at most.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
